text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Бива Хаяхидэ's
impressive, but
Нарита Таисин's tenacity
is something else!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... She looks kind of pale, though.
Don't you
think?
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Urgh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'm sure you can see... that I'm not okay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Haha... I'm pathetic.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I help her stand once she manages to
stagger up,
and we make it back to the
waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sorry for... you know, ruining everything.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Come on. You and I both know I did.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
When I saw how Hayahide and Ticket
were
getting stronger and stronger, I
panicked and got
reckless and messed
up all your plans.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And look at what happened.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure even you're fed up with me for
being such
a tiny weakling.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I KNOW!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Okay? I know the others at school
believe in me
and there are people
cheering for me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
They've always believed in me—in what I
can do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I've always known that!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I get it... That's not what I mean though...
It's me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The one who doesn't believe in me, who
calls me
short, spineless, and messed
up—who thinks I'm
completely
worthless...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: It's always been me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: ...This was all pointless.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who doesn't believe in
myself. So
running to show other people
that there's more to
me than what they
see... It was all for nothing!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Look, I'm sorry. I'm just tired.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I need a break from training... and from
racing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
